name: Anthropic Agent Skills (anthropics/skills)
summary: Anthropic's public repository of example Agent Skills: folders with a SKILL.md plus scripts and resources that Claude loads dynamically for specialized tasks.
description: Example skills covering creative, technical and enterprise tasks; each skill is a self-contained folder with a `SKILL.md` (instructions + metadata). Many skills are Apache-2.0; the document skills (`docx`, `pdf`, `pptx`, `xlsx`) are source-available rather than open source. The README describes the skills as provided for demonstration and education. The Agent Skills format itself is specified at agentskills.io.

agent_access.notes: Public GitHub repo; skills can also be installed from Claude Code's plugin system.
